steps.title: Welcome to Hybrid MVP
steps.instruction:
This mode combines settlement logistics with delegated military control.

Goal:
1. Build economy and roads.
2. Build and supply a Barracks.
3. Queue a Rifle Squad.
4. Set Attack Posture on the enemy Command Hub.

Start by clicking your Headquarters.

steps.title: Inspect Headquarters
steps.instruction: Click your Headquarters. The inspector shows stored goods and your hybrid objective progress.

steps.title: Connect roads
steps.instruction: Click Road in the build palette. Connect HQ to forest and rock so carriers can deliver materials to military sites.

steps.title: Place Barracks
steps.instruction: Click Barracks in the build palette, then click a valid hex near your road network. Military construction needs planks, stone and tools delivered by carriers.

steps.title: Watch materials arrive
steps.instruction: Press Play and watch carriers deliver wares to the military construction site. Check warnings if production is blocked.

steps.title: Barracks complete
steps.instruction: Wait until the Barracks finishes construction and connects to roads. Select it to read supply status in the inspector.

steps.title: Queue Rifle Squad
steps.instruction: Select your Barracks, then click Queue Rifle Squad. Training consumes rations and tools from your stockpile.

steps.title: Set Attack Posture
steps.instruction: Click Attack Posture, then click the enemy base on the east side of the map. Your squad will attack automatically.

steps.title: Complete the objective
steps.instruction: Press Play and watch your force destroy the enemy Command Hub to win.
